integrity: The statements are supported by an explicit analytic proof and independently scripted finite checks. No independent expert or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive aligned rank-one infection kernels; linearly independent recovery-adjusted contact profiles; both single-virus reproduction numbers exceed one; locally stable coexistence only within admissible Euler steps; no claim of global attraction or equality-boundary dynamics.
title: Strictly concave coexistence potential for aligned rank-one competitive bivirus networks
